name: testland/data-contract-extractor
description: Use for any question or task about data contracts, including what one should include and formalizing what a dataset promises after an upstream change such as a renamed column broke consumers. Reads a data PRD, dataset README or lineage doc and writes the contract: schema with types, nullability and PII flags, freshness SLA, volume bounds, distribution rules and owner, for dbt, Great Expectations or Soda.
